name: run_ledger_delist_exit
description: A held position is delisted: DELIST closes the whole position at the delist mark with 50 bps adverse slippage and a 0.0005 taker fee, exactly as E-001's delist rule (mark + 50 bps).
derivation: initial wallet 1000. AAA mult=1. FILL +2 @100 fee_rate=0.0005 slip=0: exec=100; fee=2*1*100*0.0005=0.1; wallet=999.9; entry=100; mark=100; u=0; equity=999.9. DELIST mark_price=110 fee_rate=0.0005 slippage_bps=50: closed as a FILL of -2 at price=110 with 50 bps slippage; sign=-1; exec=110*(1-1*50/1e4)=110*(1-0.005)=110*0.995=109.45. realized=(109.45-100)*2*1*sign(+1)=9.45*2=18.9; wallet=999.9+18.9=1018.8. delist fee=2*1*109.45*0.0005=109.45*0.001=0.10945; wallet=1018.8-0.10945=1018.69055; fees_cum=0.1+0.10945=0.20945. Position 0; mark becomes the delist mark_price 110 but no position remains, so unrealized=0; equity=1018.69055. If slippage were ignored, realized would be 20 and fee 0.11, final wallet 1018.9; expected 1018.69055 pins the 50 bps.
